dt: Nomination period Oct 15 - Jan 15, annually; this cycle closes Jan 15, 2027
e: Recognizes early-career researchers in electrochemical deposition science and technology who received their final degree or started work in the field no more than 10 years before the nomination deadline. Nominees must be current ECS members.
n: ECS Electrodeposition Division Early Career Investigator Award
unv: The page gives the annual Oct 15 - Jan 15 window; the 2027 closing date is taken from that annual window.
